name: @snowcone-app/example-pdp-realtime
description: Live-mockup PDP built on the @snowcone-app/canvas/embed primitives (RealtimeEmbed + RealtimeCanvas + RealtimeMockup): one declarative tree, a single design() source of truth, a bring-your-own-control input bound by layer name, and a live mockup that updates as you type. A CI-gated, cloneable reference for the ADR-0079 server-side render pipeline.
